olivia_prodsec: FYI found an upstream advisory for eBPF-loader (CVE-2026-14577). EPSS 4.2%, CVSS 7.5 (HIGH). Affects our container base images used by model-serving. Need quick triage + KMS/audit impact check. @ajay_sre @maria_eng

ajay_sre: Thanks. Can you paste the advisory link + vendor patch? Quick questions: has an exploit been observed in the wild? I'll kick off a dependency scan across clusters and check image digests. Also: which KMS key signs images (if any) and when was it last rotated?

olivia_prodsec: Link: https://vendor.example.com/advisories/ebpf-loader-2026
Patched versions: base-image 1.2.6, mitigation: disable eBPF loader via sysctl + kernel param. PoC posted in GH issue (low-fidelity PoC, requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN in container). Notes: - Attack requires privileged container or CAP_SYS_ADMIN - Our model-serving pods are NOT privileged by default, but some debug images in staging are.
SBOM quick check: `grype sbom:sbom.json | grep ebpf-loader`
Owners: maria_eng (model-serving), tom_oncall (canary monitor).

maria_eng: On it. Pipeline uses image-signer key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/img-signer-prod` in KMS, last rotation ~14 months ago. If we decide to rotate immediately we need a key-rotation window to avoid failed image verification during rollout. I'll prepare a PR to bump base -> 1.2.6 and create a backport for 1.1.x.

ajay_sre: Plan suggestion: 1) run infra scan to enumerate clusters with affected digest 2) bake patched image and run non-prod canary 3) perf/latency smoke tests + security checks 4) prod canary 5% -> 20% -> full. RBAC: enforce admission control to drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN for pods and deny privileged containers. I'll open infra PR for policy. Audit retention: propose increasing kube-audit + image-pull logs to 90d for faster investigation. @tom_oncall can you check logging cost?

tom_oncall: Cost check: 90d for security-critical indices is OK. I bumped retention for `kube-audit` and `image-pull` from 30d -> 90d in logging config (will roll out in next 2h). Also enabling KMS usage forwarding to sec-analytics for key-use alerts. Will confirm if immediate KMS rotation is safe.

vuln-bot: Automated scan: 12 clusters contain affected base image digest (list attached to ENGSEC ticket). Created issues ENGSEC-1284 (bake + canary) and ENGSEC-1285 (backport & rollout) assigned to maria_eng. CVSS vector: AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H. EPSS: 4.2% -> flagged for monitoring.

maria_eng: PR #4532 opened: bump base-image to 1.2.6, draft release notes and a backport branch release/1.1.x created. Scheduling canary for tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC on non-prod. Tagging @tom_oncall for monitor duty.

olivia_prodsec: Triage summary: severity = P2 (high). Rollout per Ajay plan. Immediate mitigations: sysctl to disable eBPF loader on nodes where possible, stricter admission controller to drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN, increase audit retention (done). Create runbook step to revoke temporary access for debug images. Postmortem only if exploit observed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
